QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_21

question.text: Category I and Category II AIFs can invest a maximum of what percentage of AUM or investable funds in a single investee company?

explanation.text: The Logic: Category I and Category II AIFs cannot invest more than 25% of AUM or investable funds in a single investee company, whether directly or through units of other AIFs. The Trap: Option A is the Category III single-investee limit. Option C is not a regulatory threshold. Option D exceeds the prescribed cap. Note: The 25% cap is the Category I/II prudential limit per the AIF Regulations chapter of the workbook.
